summary: Frontend-only read-only testing of WISECP Admin mobile app (Expo web preview, mobile viewport 390x844) against live panel https://vexa.net.tr. All core read flows verified end-to-end: Connect (success + invalid key error), Dashboard KPIs with real values, Son Müşteriler/Son Faturalar lists, pull-to-refresh wiring, Müşteriler tab (search + 4 filter chips + list), Client Detail (summary, trust score, info card, status pill, back button), Finans tab segmented (invoices/orders) with filter chips and both detail screens (Fatura #5 shows amount header, Özet, Ara Toplam, Vergi, Toplam, Ödeme, Vade, Müşteri link, Kalemler; Sipariş shows amount header, Sipariş Bilgisi, Fatura link, Kalemler, Hizmetler), Diğer tab (aktif panel kartı, paneller listesi, lock-toggle açıp kapatma). No write/destructive actions executed. No red screens, no runtime errors. Minor non-blocking console warnings observed (shadow* styles deprecated, props.pointerEvents deprecated, useNativeDriver web fallback) — standard RN-web warnings.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: "shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow". Harmless on native but noisy on web. Reference: usage of shadow* in several StyleSheet.create blocks (e.g., /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/clients.tsx FAB style and other primitives).
Console warning: props.pointerEvents is deprecated, use style.pointerEvents. Likely coming from a dependency (keyboard-controller / lucide / RN internals). Non-blocking.

action_items: (Optional) Replace deprecated shadow* StyleSheet props with boxShadow where feasible for RN-web compatibility, or ignore (works on native).

(Awareness) In Expo Router (web), previously visited tab screens remain mounted in the DOM, so duplicate testIDs (e.g., client-row-2, invoice-row-5) may coexist across routes. On native this is not an issue. Future test scripts should scope selectors to the currently visible screen (filter by visible/bbox) to avoid picking hidden duplicates.
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard (/app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx) and Clients tab both render ClientRow with the same testID derived from client.id. Not a bug per se, but combined with Expo Router's web behavior (previous screens remain mounted), it leads to duplicate data-testid in the DOM — consider prefixing testID with context (e.g., 'dash-client-row-X' vs 'clients-list-row-X') if automated web tests are a priority.
Billing invoice/order lists similarly reuse testIDs (invoice-row-{id}, order-row-{id}) that also appear on Dashboard. Same note as above.
seed_data_creation: None. Only read calls to live panel.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Web preview session is non-persistent (expo-secure-store not supported on web) — always run Connect first with URL=https://vexa.net.tr and key=wak_rEQHyEtqkbS8xStvS3ApjycTNutHnFmW. Do NOT submit new-client-submit, disconnect-button/confirm-disconnect, confirm-remove-profile — live production panel. Lock toggle is safe. When testing row clicks after tab switch, locate the visible row (previous screens remain mounted on web, so duplicates may exist); use bounding_box/is_visible to disambiguate. The dashboard click paths for client-row-2 and invoice-row-* were verified to open /client/{id} and /invoice/{id} with full data, as were segment switches on Finans and lock-toggle on Diğer.
rca_of_issue: n/a — no app bugs discovered. Initial failure to open client/invoice detail from the respective tab was a test-script artifact: on Expo Router web, Dashboard screen's DOM stays mounted after tab switch, so Playwright found the hidden Dashboard copy of client-row-2/invoice-row-5 first and clicked that. Clicking the Dashboard-visible row (or scoping to visible nodes) opens the detail correctly. Verified: /client/2 renders status pill + Özet + Güven Skoru + Bilgiler + header-back-button; /invoice/5 renders ₺108,00 amount header, Özet, Ara Toplam, Vergi, Toplam, Ödeme, Müşteri link, Kalemler.
